# Tobias Leinss, privacy-first apps

> Tobias Leinss is a full-stack engineer who builds privacy-first, on-device apps with optional bring-your-own-key (BYOK) AI: Android keyboards, voice-to-text, RSS readers, screen recorders and more. The apps run on your own device, work without accounts or a backend, and only reach the cloud when you supply your own AI key. No accounts, no telemetry, no data collection, no lock-in. Based in Germany; works in English and German.

The apps below are all local-first: data stays on your device by default, and any AI feature is optional and uses a key you bring yourself. App URLs point to on-site project pages (source repositories are private except where noted).

## Apps
- [TobiBoard](https://leinss.xyz/projects/TobiBoard/) (Android): on-device keyboard with optional BYOK AI voice-to-text and text fixing. Open source.
- [TobiReader](https://leinss.xyz/projects/TobiReader/) (Android): local-first RSS/Atom reader with on-device read-aloud, optional AI summaries, and self-hosted sync.
- [TobiRecord](https://leinss.xyz/projects/TobiRecord/) (macOS · Windows · Linux): open-source screen recorder and editor with auto-zoom, cursor polish and styled frames.
- [TobiVoice](https://leinss.xyz/projects/TobiVoice/) (macOS): native voice-to-text that transcribes locally: offline processing, data never leaves the device.
- [TobiBar](https://leinss.xyz/projects/TobiBar/) (macOS): menu-bar manager to hide, show and organise menu-bar items, with a growing toolbox of extras.
- [kAIros](https://leinss.xyz/projects/kAIros/) (Android): AI-guided goal tracking: conversational goal setup, reminders and progress with local-LLM integration.
- [finanzplanr](https://leinss.xyz/projects/finanzplanr/) (Web · Mobile): financial planning for the DACH region: household budgeting, statement parsing and AI insights.
- [taggr](https://leinss.xyz/projects/taggr/) (Web, self-hosted): AI-powered image tagging: bulk auto-tagging with a local LLM, all data stays on your machine.

## Writing
